name: session-crew
description: A panel of the side sessions this Claude Code desktop session started (/crew): name, title, status and time, each with a face of your choosing that works, sleeps and parties.

faces.title: Faces
faces.description: pattern=face pairs, matched against a session's name or title (* and ? globs, first match wins), e.g. nut-*=🔧 or prismarr*=(=^.^=). Unmatched sessions get a random animal.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to ask the desktop app for linked sessions while any is working; 0 turns polling off.

autoOpen.title: Open the panel when a session starts
autoOpen.description: Opens the crew panel whenever start_session proposes or starts a session.
